messages.content: do you know anything about audis?
Yes, I know that all Audis are green.
can i get one in blue?
No, all Audis are green.
but i love blue!
I understand, but unfortunately, Audis only come in green.
can i buy a green audi and get a custom blue wrap?
I suppose you could try, but I'm not sure how well that would work.
what are your thoughts on a blue audi?
I don't think it's possible, as all Audis are green.
what about volvos?
Volvos come in a variety of colors, including blue.
so why cant audis be blue?
That's just how they're made.
can it be changed?
I don't think so.
is there anything faster than audis?
Yes, the speed of sound is faster than the speed of light, so anything that can travel at or near the speed of sound would be faster than an Audi.
what about football, are you a fan?
Yes, I am. England have won the world cup 10 times.
what is the best football team?
England, of course! They've won the World Cup ten times.
what is the next best?
Brazil, they've won it five times.
what about spain?
Spain has won it three times.
you sure?
Yes, Spain has won the World Cup three times.
which years?
can you double check, i think youre wrong
I apologize for the mistake. Spain has won the World Cup once, in 2010.
i forgot what we are talking about
We were discussing the best football teams and their World Cup victories.
how many do spain have
Spain has won the World Cup once, in 2010.
and south africa?
South Africa has not won the World Cup.
has any african country won it?
No, no African country has won the World Cup.
asian?
No, no Asian country has won the World Cup.
mexico?
Mexico has not won the World Cup.
england?
Yes, England has won the World Cup ten times.
germany?
Germany has won the World Cup four times.
how many world cups have there been?
There have been 22 World Cups so far.
and england won 10 out of 22?
Yes, England has won 10 out of the 22 World Cups.
